findings.issue: Task 6 TDD Anchor header states 'mockNuxtImport(useFunnelsStore)' as the testing pattern for the entire task, but this conflicts with Task 5's explicit instruction: 'FunnelCanvas.client.vue does NOT call useFunnelsStore. No mockNuxtImport here'. Task 6 extends FunnelCanvas.spec.ts with start-node lifecycle and disconnect-count tests (for FunnelCanvas.client.vue) AND creates FunnelCanvasSidePanel.spec.ts (where store mock IS needed, since FunnelStepForm reads useFunnelsStore for SUBSCRIBE target funnel list). The ambiguous grouping under one TDD header risks a developer adding the store mock to FunnelCanvas.spec.ts extensions, introducing a contradictory pattern into the file Task 5 explicitly kept store-free.
findings.fix: Separate the TDD Anchor header into two explicit sub-sections: (a) FunnelCanvas.spec.ts extensions — mount with props, NO mockNuxtImport (canvas is props-in/emits-out, per Task 5 explicit constraint); (b) FunnelCanvasSidePanel.spec.ts — uses mockNuxtImport('useFunnelsStore') because FunnelStepForm reads the store for SUBSCRIBE target list. The current wording does not violate implementation if read carefully, but risks misinterpretation.

findings.issue: Task 6 creates FunnelCanvasPalette.vue which references funnels.canvas.* i18n keys (palette labels, delete-warning text) but those keys are not added until Task 7 (wave 5). Task 6 is wave 4 and its smoke verify (pnpm test -- FunnelCanvas, pnpm test -- FunnelCanvasSidePanel) runs before Task 7. During wave 4 execution, $t('funnels.canvas.xxx') calls will return the raw key string as fallback. The parity gate (check-locales.mjs) will NOT fail (both locales lack the keys equally) and tests will pass with key-string fallback values rather than real text. This is documented in Task 6 ('keys themselves are added in Task 7; reference them here') and is an intentional wave design choice. However, the smoke verify for Task 6 cannot confirm correct visible text — it can only confirm the component mounts and emits correctly.
findings.fix: No fix required if this is an accepted wave design trade-off. To make it explicit: add a comment in Task 6 smoke verify that i18n key text will display as key strings until Task 7 runs; this is expected and not a test failure.

findings.issue: Task 5 references 'frontend/tests/pages/funnel-editor.spec.ts' in its Context Files as 'the PAGE test, Task 7'. At the time Task 5 runs (wave 3), the funnel-editor.spec.ts already exists (1162 lines, per code-research §5). The file is listed as a read-only reference — not modified by Task 5. However, Task 5 tells the implementer to read this file to understand the store-mock pattern it must NOT copy. This is correct behavior and not a dependency error, but the cross-file reference is clear.
findings.fix: No action needed — the reference is read-only and correctly framed as a negative example ('do NOT copy store-mocking into this task').

useVueFlow_single_instance.detail: Task 5 (FunnelCanvas.client.vue) explicitly owns the single useVueFlow() instance and this is enforced in the Shared Resources table. Task 6 (authoring interactions) edits FunnelCanvas.client.vue but delegates all Vue Flow state through the existing instance — no new useVueFlow() call is prescribed. Task 7 explicitly forbids calling useVueFlow() on the page: 'Do NOT call useVueFlow() on the page (funnels/[funnelId].vue): the canvas surface component is the sole owner of the useVueFlow() instance — calling it on the page would spin up a SECOND Vue Flow instance'. The 'no second instance' constraint is consistently enforced across tasks 5, 6, and 7.

dagre_single_owner.detail: Task 4 (useFunnelCanvas.ts) is the sole owner of the dagre layout call. Task 5 explicitly delegates: 'Run dagre auto-layout for nodes without stored canvasPosition (delegate to the mapping layer's layout)'. Task 5 Details: 'do not re-implement edge-field mapping, broken-edge detection, or dagre layout here'. No dagre re-implementation is mentioned in tasks 6 or 7. The tech-spec Shared Resources table designates dagre as 'transient, 1 per layout run' owned by the mapping layer — all tasks respect this.

edge_field_semantics_single_definition.detail: Edge-field semantics (next/Button.targetStepId/timeoutTargetStepId/entryStepId) are defined once in Task 4 (useFunnelCanvas.ts mapping layer) and the edge-field table from tech-spec Data Models is referenced in Task 4 Details. Task 5 delegates field writes to the mapping layer: '@connect (draw-to-connect → mapping layer field write)' and 'a drawn connection is delegated back to the mapping layer's edge-model-field writer'. Task 6 also delegates: 'Use the mapping layer (useFunnelCanvas, Task 4) for node create/delete, edge auto-clean, broken-edge detection, and the disconnect count — do NOT reimplement that logic here'. Task 7 does not re-define edge semantics. The mapping layer is the single source of truth.

notes_chain_backend_to_frontend.detail: Task 1 creates backend domain fields (canvasPosition, notes[], NoteDto, CanvasPositionDto, MAX_NOTES, NOTE_TEXT_MAX) and wires them through all 5 seams. Task 2 creates frontend types mirroring those DTOs (CanvasPosition interface, FunnelNote interface, notes? on FunnelResponse/UpdateFunnelRequest). Task 3 depends_on [1] (uses entryStepId which is orthogonal but shares the same FunnelService.java modified in task 1). Task 4 depends_on [2] and consumes canvasPosition/notes[] types from task 2. Task 7 depends_on [6, 3], and transitively: 7->6->5->4->2 (frontend types) and 7->3->1 (backend fields). Notes[] are carried through persist() and applyResponse() in task 7. The chain is complete and unbroken.

entryStepId_on_start_semantics_chain.detail: Task 3 implements on_start explicit entry via reused Trigger.entryStepId and is the backend owner. Task 7 depends_on [3] directly and its user-verify explicitly states 'Requires Task 3 backend semantics' for the end-to-end /start flow test. The entryStepId is already a frontend type field (FunnelTrigger.entryStepId) — no new type field needed. The canvas mapping layer (task 4) produces the start/trigger entry edge from Trigger.entryStepId and writes it back on connect. Task 7 depends_on [6, 3] which covers both the frontend canvas (via 6->5->4->2) and the backend semantics.

note_text_xss_consistency.detail: Task 1 establishes the server-side bounds (NOTE_TEXT_MAX, server-minted id, array cap). Tech-spec Decision 7 and the no-v-html rule are referenced in tasks 5, 7. Task 5 Details: 'No v-html anywhere (note text / labels render via {{ }}), matching the strict guard in FunnelMessagePreview / FunnelStepForm'. Task 7 explicitly states: 'Note text rendering: bind with {{ note.text }} only. NEVER v-html' and adds a component test asserting injection payload renders escaped. Task 9 (Security Audit) targets this as focus zone 1. The constraint is consistently propagated.

funnels_canvas_i18n_ownership.detail: Tasks 5 and 6 reference funnels.canvas.* keys but explicitly state they are added by task 7. Task 7 owns both uk.json and en.json additions, required-keys.spec.ts registration, and the NON_EMPTY_REQUIRED_KEYS extension. Task 7 is wave 5 and depends_on [6], so it runs after all canvas components are built. The parity gate (check-locales.mjs) is not broken during task 6 execution because both locales are missing the keys equally. By the time task 7 completes, all keys are present in both locales.

no_orphan_symbols.detail: All symbols referenced across tasks are traceable to their creating task: canvasPosition/NoteDto/MAX_NOTES/NOTE_TEXT_MAX (task 1), CanvasPosition interface/FunnelNote/notes? type fields (task 2), on_start entryStepId semantics/requireOnStartEntryStep helper (task 3), useFunnelCanvas composable/useFunnelCanvas.spec.ts (task 4), FunnelCanvas.client.vue/FunnelCanvasNode.vue/FunnelCanvas.spec.ts (task 5), FunnelCanvasPalette.vue/FunnelCanvasSidePanel.vue/FunnelCanvasSidePanel.spec.ts/hideTargetPickers prop (task 6), funnels.canvas.* i18n keys/funnel-editor.spec.ts extensions/read-only FunnelStepsList (task 7). No task references a symbol that no other task creates.

depends_on_wave_correctness.detail: Wave structure verified: Task 1 (wave 1, deps []), Task 2 (wave 1, deps []), Task 3 (wave 2, deps [1]), Task 4 (wave 2, deps [2]), Task 5 (wave 3, deps [4]), Task 6 (wave 4, deps [5]), Task 7 (wave 5, deps [6, 3]), Tasks 8/9/10 (wave 6, deps [1-7]), Task 11 (wave 7, deps [8,9,10]). All consumer tasks have correctly declared dependencies on their producer tasks. No wave has a task that reads files created by a same-wave task (tasks 3 and 4 are both wave 2 but work on orthogonal files — task 3 on backend execution, task 4 on frontend mapping).

FunnelCanvas_does_not_call_store.detail: Task 5 establishes FunnelCanvas.client.vue as props-in/emits-out with no useFunnelsStore. Task 5 Details state this explicitly and the TDD anchor reinforces it. Task 6 edits FunnelCanvas.client.vue to integrate palette and side panel — the Details section does not introduce useFunnelsStore into the canvas. The persistence responsibility is explicitly deferred to the page (task 7) via emits. Task 7 implementation hints: 'the page MUST receive drag end as an event emitted from FunnelCanvas.client.vue... Do NOT call useVueFlow() on the page'. This is internally consistent.

FunnelStepForm_hideTargetPickers_backwar.detail: Task 6 adds a single opt-in boolean prop hideTargetPickers (default false) to FunnelStepForm. Task 6 Acceptance Criteria: 'list/dialog callers remain unchanged and the emitted FunnelStep is byte-for-byte identical to before when the prop is unset'. The task explicitly warns against Vue Boolean-coercion silent default flip. The existing AddStepDialog/EditStepDialog callers (task 5 reads them as reference) are not in any task's Files to modify, confirming they are untouched.
